milestones.title: M0 — Foundation and compatibility
milestones.gate: Repository scope, pinned compatible stack, real CI, accessible primitives and strict schema boundary.

milestones.title: M1 — First playable six-level slice
milestones.gate: Four free robots, six diverse puzzles, tap/drag/keyboard editor, primitive execution, tutorials, retries, ratings and local saves with actual smoke evidence.

milestones.title: M2 — Complete mechanics and authored content
milestones.gate: Repeat, latched gates, world progression, bounded content tooling and four fully authored 15-level worlds.

milestones.title: M3 — Polish, offline and inclusive validation
milestones.gate: Final-art review, storage/update hardening, equivalent board explorer, real-device evidence and consented formative playtests.

milestones.title: M4 — Public web v1 readiness
milestones.gate: Exact release candidate with 60 valid levels, privacy/support/asset review, deployment/rollback rehearsal and human GO/NO-GO.

milestones.title: M5 — Optional post-v1 expansion
milestones.gate: Opt-in native packaging, internal authoring tool or separate cloud-save proposal. Excluded from default issue import.

tasks.title: Adopt the specification and establish repository boundaries
scope: Inspect the supplied repository or initialize a new one only when authorized; record branch and worktree state
Place this planning kit under a stable documented path and establish contribution/evidence conventions
Record unresolved owner choices without changing the game scope
acceptance: No existing work is overwritten or unrelated project files imported
README points to PRD, architecture, design references and task order
Initial repository inventory distinguishes existing code from planned work
tests: Run package verification and record actual results
Check all local documentation links resolve

tasks.title: Prove and pin the React–Phaser toolchain
scope: Spike a React shell with one Phaser scene and responsive resize
Evaluate Phaser 4.2.1 as a candidate with a supported Node 24 LTS patch and compatible tools
Record exact versions, remove template log.js telemetry and unused starter behavior
acceptance: Clean install and production build reproduce from the lockfile
Scene mounts, resizes, destroys and remounts without duplicate canvases
Basic touch and rendering work in recorded browser probes; unsupported probes are explicit
tests: Run mount/unmount and Strict Mode probes
Capture actual tool versions and network destinations during dev/build

tasks.title: Bootstrap quality tooling and honest CI scripts
scope: Create the proposed core/ui/renderer/storage boundaries and strict TypeScript configuration
Implement real lint, typecheck, unit-test, production-build and browser-test commands
Create CI jobs with pinned runners/toolchain and artifact retention
acceptance: No test script merely echoes success
Core import rules forbid React, Phaser and browser storage dependencies
A deliberately failing test fails the corresponding CI job
tests: Run clean install, typecheck, lint, unit tests and build
Verify failing-test and missing-content negative probes

tasks.title: Build responsive tokens and accessible base components
scope: Implement spacing, type, palette, focus and safe-area tokens
Create buttons, dialog, status chip, cards and loading/error primitives
Add an isolated component showcase for review
acceptance: Primary targets are at least 48 CSS pixels
Disabled, focused and error states are perceivable beyond color
Components reflow at 360 px and 200% zoom without unreachable controls
tests: Measure target sizes and contrast in representative states
Keyboard-test dialog entry, escape and focus return

tasks.title: Implement schema and semantic content validation
scope: Adopt the supplied level/program/draft/world/robot/save schemas with strict runtime validation
Implement semantic board, ID, gate-reference and capability checks
Return stable structured errors with useful paths
acceptance: Unknown fields and incompatible versions fail before gameplay
Byte, array, coordinate and AST limits are enforced
All supplied valid examples pass and malformed variants fail clearly
tests: Test duplicate coordinates, bad gate targets, start on goal and forbidden commands
Test oversized input and future-version rejection

tasks.title: Implement immutable board and facing model
scope: Create pure position/facing/entity types and normalized state creation
Implement cardinal rotations and passability lookup
Establish sorted ID-set serialization for deterministic fixtures
acceptance: Initial state has no implicit pickups or gate opening
Four identical turns restore facing
Caller-owned inputs cannot be mutated by normalization or stepping
tests: Test all four headings and tile boundaries
Freeze inputs and verify state operations remain safe

tasks.title: Implement primitive command compilation and simulation
scope: Compile forward/left/right nodes with source IDs
Execute actions without renderer, timers or wall-clock state
Return before/after states and blocked-target reasons
acceptance: Turning does not change tile and forward follows logical facing
Blocked attempts consume one action and preserve the last legal position
Repeated identical input yields identical trace JSON
tests: Golden-test simple routes, all turn combinations and void/wall collisions
Assert original level/program objects are unchanged

tasks.title: Implement goals, pickups, budgets and rating outcomes
scope: Apply collectible entry effects and required-goal conditions
Implement static block cap and runtime action cap with specified precedence
Calculate per-run completion/bonus/efficiency award bits
acceptance: Success on the last allowed action is accepted
Goal without required items can be visited and left without winning
Trailing unused nodes count toward blocks but not executed actions
tests: Test incomplete vs out_of_actions vs blocked distinction
Verify optional-detour and direct-route ratings against fixtures

tasks.title: Build the pure program-editing reducer
scope: Implement add/insert/reorder/replace/delete/clear actions with stable node IDs
Support bounded undo and a distinct draft-to-runnable validation step
Keep capacity accounting centralized and reusable by all input methods
acceptance: At least 50 current-level operations are undoable
Canceling an edit leaves draft unchanged
Clear and reset have separate effects; capacity is never silently exceeded
tests: Property-test reorder/undo and unique IDs
Test replacement at full capacity and empty draft serialization

tasks.title: Implement tap, pointer drag and keyboard program editing
scope: Build semantic palette, insertion slots and block action menu
Implement pointer threshold/capture, insertion preview and canceled drops
Provide equivalent tap-to-place and keyboard operations with announcements
acceptance: Every edit is possible without dragging
Off-target drops and pointercancel never leave ghost blocks
Focus follows edits and native page scrolling remains usable
tests: Run touch/pointer integration tests and keyboard-only flows
Test full strip, landscape, Escape cancel and screen-reader edit announcements

tasks.title: Render the isometric board with reliable depth and framing
scope: Implement integer-grid projection and consistent foot pivots
Render terrain, walls, goal and pickups from data
Fit board to its available rectangle and use deterministic object depth
acceptance: Logical tile positions agree with rendered markers at each facing
Tall decoration cannot obscure critical board information
Resize changes framing only, not simulation state
tests: Capture board at all required viewport classes
Test robot depth on both sides of tall scenery and no-WebGL recovery entry

tasks.title: Create four consistent placeholder robot asset sets
scope: Provide clearly labeled temporary Pip, Mochi, Bolt and Sprout assets
Match directional poses, dimensions and ground pivots
Map semantic asset-set IDs to local trusted files
acceptance: All four characters are recognizably robotic
No robot changes rule parameters or occludes a different number of tiles
Missing art falls back visibly without crashing
tests: Preview all poses and selected portraits side by side
Verify asset IDs and equal logical traces for each robot ID

tasks.title: Build the typed controller–renderer bridge and lifecycle
scope: Implement controller messages and renderer acknowledgments with runId and step index
Ignore stale/out-of-order events
Dispose all scene subscriptions, timers and owned resources on teardown
acceptance: No simulation or scoring happens inside scene callbacks
Old acknowledgments cannot mutate a new run
Repeated navigation does not add duplicate listeners/canvases
tests: Mount/destroy 100 times in a lifecycle probe
Inject stale and duplicate acknowledgments and inspect resulting state

tasks.title: Implement run, pause, resume, step and reset
scope: Connect an immutable program snapshot to trace playback
Implement action-boundary pause and cancellation/reset
Pause on hidden page and require deliberate resume
acceptance: Edit operations are blocked during running/paused playback
Reset preserves draft, restores board and grants no canceled completion
Single Step advances exactly one primitive and stops at the next boundary
tests: Test pause/reset at beginning, mid-tween and final success step
Verify background/resume and repeated Run clicks do not duplicate execution

tasks.title: Build the mobile-first application shell and routes
scope: Implement welcome, gameplay, robot picker and settings navigation
Use portrait dock and wide-screen editor panel
Handle route loading, safe areas and invalid route recovery
acceptance: New users enter play without signup or install prompt
360 px and landscape layouts keep controls reachable
Navigation does not leave background game/audio activity
tests: Run viewport screenshot matrix
Test back/forward, invalid URL and navigation during a draft

tasks.title: Implement robot selection consistently across the game
scope: Build four free starter cards with large preview and selected check
Persist confirmed selection through the storage adapter
Use the selected character in welcome, board, tutorial/hint and results
acceptance: Changing robot preserves drafts, awards and world progress
Selection can be changed without payment or game advantage
Mid-run changes are deferred or require reset, never swap an active sprite unsafely
tests: Reload and verify selected robot
Compare a fixture trace and ratings for all four robot choices

tasks.title: Implement first-command visual tutorials

Expose replay/skip and reduced-motion keyframes

tasks.title: Implement helpful retry, hint and success panels

tasks.title: Implement local save adapter and in-memory fallback

Persist edits and selected robot with explicit error handling

acceptance: Reload restores stable drafts and settings but not an in-flight run

tasks.title: Integrate and validate the first six diverse puzzles
scope: Adapt w1-01 through w1-06 examples to production content/locale paths

acceptance: The six levels cover forward, both turns, pickup, optional detour and obstacle correction

tasks.title: Validate the first playable vertical slice
scope: Exercise choose robot → tutorial → edit/run/retry → six-level progression → reload
Capture actual viewport screenshots and a short interaction recording
Write M1 evidence and unresolved limitations
acceptance: All four robots and six puzzles work from the same production build

tests: Run core tests, production build and browser smoke journeys

tasks.title: Implement bounded repeat compilation and core rules

tasks.title: Build the responsive repeat-block editor

acceptance: Repeat child blocks are counted even when the group is collapsed

tasks.title: Add repeat tutorials and execution visualization
scope: Create repeat demonstration with count and body cues
Show current child and iteration while playing/stepping
Keep reduced-motion and non-audio feedback equivalent
acceptance: Child command rather than only header is highlighted

tests: Pause and step at each repeat boundary

tasks.title: Implement latched switches and gates end to end
scope: Add switch-entry effects and gate passability to the core
Render closed/open gates and matched shape/color signals

tasks.title: Implement world map, level picker and unlock rules

acceptance: Replaying cannot repeatedly grant the same cosmetic

Minima from separate runs are not represented as one fictitious run

tasks.title: Harden save migrations, import/export and erase
